title: Release Engineering & Commercial Productization
objective: Prepare Multiversal for an actual supported release after product, validation and owner gates permit it, hardening BRP beta-grade operational systems to commercial/release grade rather than duplicating them. Scope includes release packaging/channels, approved subscriptions or entitlements and billing integration, production operations, hardened backup/observability/support tooling, crash/error reporting, rollback, privacy/legal readiness, stores/distribution and launch operations.
acceptance: A release candidate can be deployed, observed, supported, rolled back and recovered through documented production procedures with owner-approved commercial/legal dependencies satisfied.
boundaries: SMB-01..17, BRP-01..11 and their sealed owner contracts remain completed predecessor authority.
SMB-18 is selected_not_started only and has no implementation authority until governed start.
Subscriptions, entitlements, billing, stores, paid providers, production infrastructure and launch operations must remain conditional on the explicit owner/commercial/legal gates that apply to them.
SMB-18 hardens beta-grade operational systems rather than creating duplicate identity, gameplay, content, rights, safety, observability, recovery or support authority.
Any future P3D manufacturing/print-service commerce remains separately owner/provider gated even within SMB-18.
next_action: SMB-18 is completed_verified with RELEASE_CANDIDATE_READY evidence. The SMB program is completed_verified. No downstream gpr roadmap item is selected; public launch and unapproved commercial/legal/provider activations remain separately gated.
